free_tier_limits: Free plan: 10,000 credits/month shared across products (TTS, STT, music, SFX, etc.); TTS typically ~0.5–1 credit per character by model (e.g. Multilingual v2 = 1 credit/char; Flash/Turbo API often 0.5); commercial licensing requires a paid plan
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official pricing (https://elevenlabs.io/pricing) lists Free at 10k credits/month shared across products; FAQ states Multilingual v2 = 1 credit/char and Flash/Turbo API ~0.5–1 credit/char; Commercial License is listed under Starter+, not Free. Docs also note credits were formerly called characters (https://elevenlabs.io/docs/help-center/account/general/have-characters-changed).
